correctness.rationale: For every phase-indexed periodic binary word (including n=1,2,3), local x_i=x_{i+1} or x_i=x_{i+3} excludes exactly 0101,0111,1000,1010. At each run ending, the next run must have length <=2 and two neighboring singleton runs cannot occur; the converse checks each run end. The 8-state order-three transfer graph has trace A^n=N_n, and removing the two constant fixed cycles splits its six-state component into complementary 3x3 blocks with characteristic polynomials lambda^3-lambda-1 and lambda^3+lambda-1. Log-det produces the exact stated dynamical zeta and recurrences. The strongly connected component has coprime cycle lengths 3,4, yielding entropy log plastic constant; Mobius inversion gives primitive orbit census. Independently enumerated all 16,382 phase-indexed words lengths 1..13 and independently computed trace counts 2,2,8,6,2,8,16,6,8,32,24,12,54. No enumeration proves the all-n transfer identity.
